WITH updated AS (
            UPDATE prompts
            SET
                title = COALESCE($2, title),
                description = CASE WHEN $3 THEN $4 ELSE description END,
                tags = CASE WHEN $5 THEN COALESCE($6, '{}'::text[]) ELSE tags END,
                category = CASE WHEN $7 THEN $8 ELSE category END,
                type_id = CASE WHEN $9 THEN $10 ELSE type_id END
            WHERE id = $1
            RETURNING
                id,
                slug,
                title,
                description,
                tags,
                category,
                type_id,
                created_at,
                updated_at
         )
         SELECT
            u.id,
            u.slug AS "slug!",
            u.title AS "title!",
            u.description,
            u.tags AS "tags!",
            u.category,
            u.type_id,
            pt.name AS "type_name!",
            u.created_at AS "created_at!",
            u.updated_at AS "updated_at!",
            production.version AS "production_version?",
            production.created_at AS "production_version_created_at?"
         FROM updated u
         INNER JOIN prompt_types pt ON pt.id = u.type_id
         LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
             SELECT
                pv.version,
                pv.created_at
             FROM prompt_versions pv
             WHERE pv.prompt_id = u.id
               AND pv.stage = 'PRODUCTION'::prompt_stage
             ORDER BY pv.version DESC
             LIMIT 1
         ) AS production ON TRUE
